main_text.p: Lect.Evang.Plur.קודשין, Syr. ܩܕܝܫܐ ܩܕܝܫܐ : Ch. & Syr.Sanctuarium: Item Res sancta, Numer.18.29. Plur. מקדשי, מקדשין.
קדושא Ch.Idem, Psal.68.18.25. Item Sanctitas, Levit. 21.9.Ezech.16.11.25.
מקדשתא Ch. Meretrix, Scortum, Heb.קדשה Gen.38.21.

קהא Ch. Caligare, Idem quod אריי קהאה עינוהי, כהא Quia caligabant oculi ejus,1.Reg.14.4.Item Obstupescere, Obtusum fieri, Genef.33.4. in Targ. Hierof. Item Divellere, luxare: vel luxari, luxatum pendere,Gen.32.25.in T.Hier. (mos 4.6.
אקהיות Ch. Stupor, hebetudo, dentium proprie, A-Hebr. Congregare. Hinc קהלת Congregans, Congregatrix sc. anima Regis Salomonis: Ecclesiastes, ut Hebraicè, Eccl.1.
קהלא, קהל Ch.Congregatio, Coetus, Ecclesia, Heb.קהל. קובתא, קובא קוב* Vide supra in קבב.
קוד Syr. Scindere, Findere, Rumpere, Unde Particip. ܩܪܝ Lucae 5.36.
קוה Syr. Exspectare, praestolari, subsistere, manere, permanere.Hebr.קוה.
קוין Ch. Tele, קוין דעכוביתא Telae araraneapum, Jesa.59.56.
מקוה Ch.Netum,filatum,1.Reg,10.28.Item Conceptaculum, congregatio aquarum,Plur. מקויא Conceptacula aquarum, Jes.22.11.
קוח Ch. Balii, varii coloris equi,Zach.1.8.Hebr. שרקים,quod ita a plerisque interpretibus exponitur.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are transcribed as far as legible; several Syriac and Hebrew forms in the scan are blurred and uncertain, and the first Syriac entry and the Hebrew in the "Telae" line are doubtful. The final word קוט is a catchword-like line at the foot right.
